findings.evidence: Same file: `transverseProj_nPlus_eq_zero` (225), `transverseProj_nMinus_eq_zero` (229), `plus_nMinus_eq_zero` (145), `minus_nPlus_eq_zero` (149), `plus_transverseProj_eq_zero` (203). The parents are `AlternatingMap.bilinMap_apply_left_eq_zero` / `bilinMap_apply_right_eq_zero` (EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/Alternating/BilinMap.lean:70,76), invoked verbatim in these proofs.
findings.issue: `transverseEps_nPlus_left` (361), `transverseEps_nMinus_left` (365), `transverseEps_nPlus_right` (369), `transverseEps_nMinus_right` (373), `transverseEpsLin_nPlus` (426) and `transverseEpsLin_nMinus` (430) all conclude `= 0` but name only the LHS, contradicting the file's own convention and the parent lemmas they specialise.

findings.evidence: Adjacent Minkowski specialisations in the same namespace all mark themselves: `minkowskiAxis_plus_apply` (145), `mem_transverse_minkowskiAxis_iff` (160), `finrank_transverse_minkowskiProduct_add_one_eq` (169), `finrank_transverse_minkowskiProduct_eq_two` (178).
findings.fix: Carry the specialisation marker the neighbouring lemmas use, e.g. `transverseEpsLin_minkowskiProduct_apply`, `transverseEpsLin_minkowskiProduct_comp_self`.
findings.issue: `transverseEpsLin_apply` (195), `transverseEpsLin_transverseEpsLin` (227) and `transverseEpsLin_comp_self` (240) live in the same `LinearMap.BilinForm.LightConeBasis` namespace as the general theory but hold only for `minkowskiProduct (d := 3)`. `transverseEpsLin_apply` in particular is the natural name for the generic evaluation lemma of the definition at BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean:402, and now claims it.

findings.evidence: `transverseEpsLin_volumeForm_eq_volumeFormRaise` (Relativity/LightConeBasis.lean:204): `L.transverseEpsLin volumeForm … u = volumeFormRaise L.nPlus L.nMinus u`; both docstrings describe "the second index raised".
findings.fix: Pick one suffix for index raising and use it in both places (e.g. `transverseEpsRaise`, keeping `volumeFormRaise`).
findings.issue: Two suffixes for one notion: `volumeFormRaise` (VolumeForm.lean:167) and `transverseEpsLin` (BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean:402) both name the index-raised contraction, and the PR proves they are the same object.

findings.evidence: Bases live in the namespace of their space upstream (`EuclideanSpace.basisFun`, `Pi.basisFun`); the sibling file EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/LightFront.lean:96 opens `namespace Lorentz.Vector` for its Lorentz-vector declarations rather than root `EpsilonEridani`.
findings.fix: Name it for its space, e.g. `Lorentz.Vector.basisFin4` (as the sibling file does for Lorentz-vector material) or `minkowskiBasisFin4`.
findings.issue: `EpsilonEridani.basisFin4` is an unqualified root-namespace name that does not say what it is a basis of; it is specifically the standard basis of `Lorentz.Vector 3`.

summary: Six new lemmas concluding `= 0` drop the `_eq_zero` suffix that the surrounding declarations and their own parent lemmas use, and three Minkowski-only lemmas in the shared `LightConeBasis` namespace are named as if they held for any bilinear form. Also a split convention (`Lin` vs `Raise`) for the same index-raising operation.
